assignment_disposition.summary: A fail-closed PR-171 harness is feasible only if the spec, source provenance, schema-v2 CAS contract, generation-scoped pre-axis authorization, four blind axis assignments, strict collector, physical-admissibility gate, post-CAS scientific-contract review, terminal router, mutation gate, and manifest are conjunctive. Four-axis computational agreement alone must not authorize a no-go statement or a numerical suppression result.

findings.summary: The current PR card and shared context prohibit freezing a numerical suppression conclusion, while the older roadmap still names a 1e-6..1e-7 value. The PR-171 spec must resolve this drift before any axis is authorized.
requirements: Declare the current backlog card plus the new PR-171 spec as execution authority; retain the roadmap text as historical candidate wording, not a numerical conclusion.
Freeze the suppression functional, domain, denominator guards, input provenance, evaluation rule, precision, and reporting format before results, but leave the output value null until evaluation.
Add a live claim mutation that injects 1e-6 or 1e-7 as a preregistered conclusion and require the production validator to reject it.
Bind the immutable backlog card and its machine-readable mirror by semantic hash so the candidate wording is superseded by a result receipt rather than rewritten after results.

findings.summary: PR-171 needs an equation-complete, non-vacuous schema-v2 contract. The PR-168 history proves that four engines can agree under a scientifically invalid contract, and PR-170 tests show why exact non-empty inventories and negative controls are mandatory.
requirements: Freeze an exact dynamical-class identifier and exclusions; PR-125 frame/order/background/units fields; time variable and orientation; equation-of-state domain including endpoint treatment; Gamma domain and dimensions; momentum-conservation and closure assumptions; positivity and denominator guards.

Freeze the complete three- or four-variable background state vector and ODE right-hand side, equilibrium, invariant/domain conditions, and the exact 2x2 linearized subsystem with an explicit derivation map from the background ODE.

Freeze the stability predicate, characteristic polynomial/eigenvalue target, quantifiers, interval or asymptotic meaning, and what constitutes decay. A local linear statement may not be silently promoted to nonlinear/global relaxation.

Freeze a suppression functional with numerator, denominator, norm, time interval, initial-data set, units, guards, and evaluation inputs. Expected exact canonical forms may be frozen; the eventual numerical suppression value may not be.
Freeze a physically admissible persistent-tilt falsifier and negative controls for time/sign reversal, w_X=1/3 boundary handling, Gamma=0, nondecay, denominator zero, and frame/tilt sign conventions.

Require a non-empty exact allowlist of source-input hashes and per-axis source hashes, exact commands, required tools, unique obligation IDs, expected canonical values/forms, no exceptions, blind-results mode, and cross-version-result-reuse=false.

Represent all four backlog-required axes exactly. If internal keys remain wolfram_xact, sympy, sage_singular, lean, the contract must bind an explicit mapping to Wolfram+xAct, SymPy plus high-precision checks, SageMath+Singular, and Lean+mathlib; aliases or a missing high-precision receipt are invalid evidence.

Any change to an equation, convention, domain, source, fixture, expected form, axis source, or semantic negative control changes the contract/generation hash and requires four fresh blind assignments and results.

findings.summary: Each axis must be bound to an immutable authorization root created before any result exists. PR-170's hardened runner and collector provide the minimum pattern; PR-171 should strengthen it by binding the collector, result router, mutation registry, and explicit pre-result state as well.
requirements: The authorization receipt must contain generation_id, context_version, run_dir, contract path/hash, spec/provenance/source-verifier hashes, axis-runner hash, collector hash, result-router hash, mutation-registry hash, exact axis-source inventories, and source-verification receipt/hash.

For each of exactly four assignments, bind both the canonical assignment self-hash and file-byte SHA-256; validate schema, run/assignment IDs, axis, claim IDs, context, blind-results, allowed_sibling_results=[], canonical unique result path, required outputs, and every required-input hash.
Record that all four generation-specific result paths were absent before axes_authorized=true. An authorization created or rewritten after an axis result exists is invalid.

Authorization succeeds only with errors=[], authenticated source closure for the claimed equations, exact axis set, no registered exception, and current context. Tool-readiness receipts may be bound but must say preflight_not_scientific_validation.

The authorization file is immutable. Drift in any bound byte or a validator/runner repair requires a new generation ID and four fresh assignments; old FAIL/BLOCKED/PASS receipts remain preserved and cannot be overwritten.
axis_runner_contract: Recompute assignment, contract, authorization, and every input/source hash before execution.
Execute only the contract command in the declared cwd/environment and record every exit, tool version, precision/tolerance/seed where applicable, and a bounded transcript reference.

Emit the full obligation keyset, canonical computed forms, fixture results, assumption differences, structured counterexample, verified hashes, authorization hash, completed_at, and sibling_results_read=[].

Classify missing executable, timeout, license/package failure as BLOCKED only with a machine-readable platform receipt. Do not infer a platform block from one magic exit code or silently turn an unparseable mathematical run into BLOCKED.

findings.summary: The collector must reconstruct evidence from assignments and nested results, preserve failed generations, and be followed by a separate scientific-contract review. Summary fields or majority agreement are not authority.
requirements: Rebuild from exact assignment and outer result files; verify assignment self/file hashes, authorization binding, context, result path, contract/source/input hashes, outer/nested identity and status alignment, commands/tool versions, obligation keyset, canonical values, fixture status, counterexample semantics, and blinding.

Reject missing/duplicate/unknown axes, altered commands, substituted sources, post-hoc context or assignment rewrites, stale authorization, cross-generation reuse, PASS with nonzero exits/false checks, FAIL without concrete evidence, and any trusted precomputed collection summary.

Use only CAS_4AXIS_PASS, CAS_BLOCKED, CAS_CONFLICT, CAS_FAIL, and the unavailable-by-policy exception state. PR-171 registers no exception, so CAS_PASS_WITH_REGISTERED_EXCEPTION is invalid. Majority vote is always false.
Treat malformed or forgeable evidence as PROCESS_EVIDENCE_INVALID before CAS aggregation, not as CAS_FAIL and not as a scientific counterexample.

Durably copy each assignment, outer envelope, normalized nested result, authorization, and adjudication into a generation-specific content-addressed directory. Never overwrite a differing prior generation. Provide byte-reproducible --check mode.
A repaired contract or axis input gets a new contract/version and four fresh blind axes. Preserve earlier CAS_FAIL/CAS_BLOCKED and its source snapshot as immutable evidence, following PR-169.

After computational aggregation, run an independent post-CAS scientific-contract review that can invalidate a computational CAS_4AXIS_PASS. Production/result authorization is conjunctive on both reviews, following the PR-168 failure branch.

findings.summary: External mechanism attribution, exact ODE algebra, source-space closure, and physical admissibility are distinct gates. CAS agreement cannot establish that the model class is complete or that a persistent-tilt trajectory is physically admissible.
requirements: Create a PR-171 primary-source provenance registry that separates Coley-Hervik-Lim mechanism attribution from khronon/non-comoving-dark-sector loophole sources. Do not use the loophole source as assumed closure.

For every source bind identifier/version, authors/title, retrieval URL, raw archive path/hash/bytes, equation-record path/hash, exact locator, quoted-symbol-free normalized equation record, assumptions, and a symbol/frame/time crosswalk into PR-125 types.
The source verifier must require raw authenticated archives for authorization; equation-record-only verification may be a CI convenience but cannot authorize axes or a result.

Define a source-space closure receipt and a same-state physical-admissibility bundle covering the frozen model equations, constraints/conservation, positivity/domain conditions, frame/congruence mapping, background solution existence, perturbation validity, initial/boundary data, and the persistent-tilt trajectory/falsifier.
A finite search that finds no persistent tilt is not source-space closure. Missing closure or any physical receipt forces algebraic_only or non_informative even after CAS_4AXIS_PASS.

This assignment did not authenticate external sources because its allowed tool/input slice excluded web access and source archives; source acquisition and verification remain pre-authorization main-writer work.

findings.summary: PR-171 needs live mutations against the production validators for both success and every blocked/failure/counterexample route, plus a total routing table that withholds scientific values whenever a conjunctive gate is missing.

findings.mutation_receipt_rule: Every mutation row must carry a stable mutation_id, target, bound target semantic/file hash, exact changed field or fixture, execution_kind, expected violation, observed violation, command, exact test node, tool version, and detected=true. Every route-specific registry count must be exact and no survivor may be replaced after results.

terminal_routing.when: CAS_4AXIS_PASS AND post_cas_contract_review_pass AND exact_class_closure_pass AND all_physical_receipts_pass AND stability_target_pass

findings.summary: The result pack must be generated from raw bound evidence, reproduce byte-for-byte in check mode, carry minimum metadata, and include PR-151 start/end fast-probe receipts without racing the background acquisition.
requirements: Generate a result card, exact stability receipt, suppression-functional receipt, source-provenance receipt, source-space closure report, physical-admissibility/falsifier report, candidate supersession/retirement receipt, active-consumer inventory, mutation report, CAS collection/adjudication, and content-addressed manifest.

Every artifact carries owner, implementation scope, claim tier/level, hypothesis_only mode, public_use=false, transfer source, config hash, input hashes, sky/mask/covariance/null status, caveats, generating command, runtime/tool versions, git commit, and worktree state.
The result generator must call the collector's pure rebuild path and require semantic/byte equality with the on-disk collection; it must never trust aggregate or scalar fields supplied by a caller.
Write through validated temporary files and atomic replacement only after every output is built. --check compares every expected byte and manifest hash without mutation.

Record read-only PR-151 fast probes at PR-171 start and end. Do not rehash payloads, start another downloader, or write PR-151 tracked finalization artifacts. If terminal-ready at the end, complete atomic PR-171 review/commit before switchback.

Implement the typed ODE/stability/suppression substrate plus source and physical validators, without emitting a result.
Freeze schema-v2 CAS contract, four axis source trees, mutation registry, commands, and expected canonical forms.
Register four fresh blind assignments and create immutable pre-axis authorization after verifying zero pre-existing results.
Run four axes independently; collect and seal the generation; execute independent post-CAS contract review.
Run source-space/physical/falsifier gates and total terminal router; execute route-specific live mutations.

all raw archives and normalized equation records match the frozen provenance registry

one unique result envelope bound to the same contract and authorization root; never execute sibling axes in one assignment

risks_and_kill_switches: Roadmap/backlog numerical-target drift: block authorization until the spec records precedence and the literal-threshold mutation is killed.
Underdefined equations or negative controls: PROCESS_FAIL; do not run axes.
Any changed bound input after authorization: invalidate generation and require four fresh blind axes.
Missing/unavailable axis: CAS_BLOCKED; three passes do not substitute.
Assumption or canonical-form disagreement: CAS_CONFLICT; majority vote forbidden.
Valid mathematical counterexample/proof failure: CAS_FAIL; withhold no-go and suppression claims.
Four-axis pass under an invalid scientific contract: post-CAS review supersedes computational pass and forbids result authorization.
Physically admissible persistent tilt: retire the proposed no-go within the frozen class.
Missing source-space closure or physical receipt: algebraic_only/non_informative; no generic-fluid no-go.
Invalid suppression denominator, missing authenticated inputs, or nonconvergent evaluation: suppression_result=null with a typed non-informative status.
PR-151 terminal readiness: finish atomic PR-171 review/commit, then switch back; never start a new advocate card first.
